difficulty_reason: Purity of branch locus (Nagata): induction on d = dim O_{X,x}. The d = 1 case reads unramified-at-x off hypothesis (5), flatness from normal-curve over DVR (quasi-finite forbids the non-flat case, flagged 'some details omitted'), and flat + unramified = etale. For d >= 2: etale-local reduction to a finite morphism with x the unique point over y, base change to the regular local O_{Y,y}, going-down from normality of the finite injective extension, the dimension base-fibre identity, and the induction hypothesis etale at every other point - arriving at a finite local etale-on-punctura extension of regular by normal of dimension d >= 2, dispatched to lemma-local-purity. Retained author proof at lines 5367-5430. Statement carries reference/history navigation environments with citations (emptied by the lane patch; span body is cite-free after the scan).

compared.note: Branch-locus purity theorem; consumes lemma-local-purity (built in the same wave); distinct from lemma-purity-ramification (ramification locus variant) and lemma-local-purity (regular local case).
